bs-translationtransfer-desc: Waxay awood u siinaysaa tarjumaadda iyo wareejinta bogagga u dhexeeya tusaalooyinka wiki-yada
log-description-bs-translation-transfer: Diiwaankani wuxuu ka kooban yahay macluumaad ku saabsan tarjumaadaha cinwaannada.
bs-translation-transfer-local-no-languag: Luuqado sax ah oo tarjumaad ah lama helin
bs-translation-transfer-outdated-transla: Tarjumaaddani waa duugowday. Fadlan hubi '''[$1 luuqadda isha]'''
bs-translation-transfer-overview-source-: Taariikhda ugu dambaysay ee wax ka beddelka bogga isha
bs-translation-transfer-overview-target-: Taariikhda ugu dambaysay ee isbeddelka bogga bartilmaameedka
bs-translation-transfer-new-draft-transl: Qabyo tarjumaad cusub ayaa jirta. '''[$1 Hubi qabyo qoraalka]'''
bs-translation-transfer-translation-exis: Bogga "$1" lama turjumin sababtoo ah tarjumaad la soo jeediyey ayaa hore u jirta oo ku xiran bog kale. Fadlan magaca bogga beddel si aad u hesho tarjumaad kale.
bs-translation-transfer-config-namespace: Dooro magacyada ee meel magacyada ee loo isticmaali doono turjumaadda
bs-translation-transfer-ui-source-namesp: Meel magaca ku jira wiki-ga isha
Dooro meel-magaca wiki-ga isha ee loo isticmaalo turjumaadaha
bs-translation-transfer-ui-target-namesp: Waxay qeexaysaa sida meel magaca isha loogu magacaabo luqadda la doortay.
bs-translation-transfer-ui-target-lang-h: Waxay qeexaysaa luqadda loo isticmaalo tarjumaadda meel magaca
bs-translation-transfer-dictionary-desc: Dhammaan tarjumaadaha jira ayaa halkan lagu taxay, waana la tafatiri karaa ama la tirtiri karaa. Tarjumaado cusub si gaar ah ayaa loogu dari karaa inta lagu jiro habka tarjumaadda bogga.
bs-translation-transfer-dictionary-edit-: Fadlan taxaddar markaad wax ka beddelayso tarjumaadaha. Isbeddelladu waxay wax ka beddeli doonaan cinwaanka bogga, dhammaan xiriirrada boggan ku xiranina waa in gacanta lagu cusboonaysiiyaa
{{PLURAL:$1|Hal bog ayaa u baahan|$1 bog ayaa u baahan}} in gacanta lagu cusboonaysiiyo. Eeg [$2 dhammaan bogagga ay saameeyeen].
Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad tarjumaadda ka beddesho $1 una beddesho $2?
bs-translation-transfer-dictionary-trans: Turjumaad la soo jeediyey ayaa hore ugu jirta il kale oo ku jirta isla meel magaca.
bs-translation-transfer-dictionary-remov: Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad ka saarto tarjumaadda $1?
bs-translation-transfer-special-page-not: Waxay u muuqataa inaad ka maqan tahay qaar ka mid ah habaynta BlueSpiceTranslationTransfer. Fadlan la xiriir maamulahaaga si uu si sax ah u habeeyo.
bs-translation-transfer-glossary-sync-er: Cilad ayaa dhacday intii lagu jiray isku dubaridka qaamuuska
bs-translation-transfer-config-namespace: Meel magacyada ee loo hawlgeliyay turjumaadda
Dooro meelaha magacyada lagu darayo habka shaqada turjumaadda ee wiki-gan
bs-translation-transfer-ui-related-resou: Khayraad dheeraad ah ayaa la wareejiyay.
Bogaggan si guul leh ayaa loo wareejiyay, mana u baahna wax hagaajin dheeraad ah.
Bogaggan si otomaatig ah looma wareejin karin. Fadlan hubi nuxurka oo samee hagaajinta lagama maarmaanka ah.
Waxay muujisaa sababta aan bogga loo wareejin
bs-translation-transfer-related-file-pus: Faylka lama gudbin karin sababtoo ah kordhimooyin kale ayaa faragelinaya habka. Fadlan hubi kordhimooyinkaaga ama la xiriir maamulahaaga.
Faylku wuxuu ku jiraa wiki-ga isha, laakiin jidka maxalliga ahi waa khaldan yahay.
bs-translation-transfer-related-title-pu: Dib u eegis looma heli karin cinwaanka isha.
Macluumaadka dib u eegista lagama soo heli karin wiki-ga bartilmaameedka.
Macluumaadka dib u eegista lagama soo heli karin jawaab aan sax ahayn awgeed.
Bog cinwaankan leh ayaa hore uga jira wiki-ga bartilmaameedka, mana la xiriiro bogga isha.
Boggu hore ayuu uga jiray wiki-ga bartilmaameedka, waxna iskama beddelin wiki-ga isha tan iyo markii ugu dambaysay ee la wareejiyay
Boggu hore ayuu uga jiray wiki-ga bartilmaameedka waana wax laga beddelay.
Wareejintu way fashilantay sababo la xiriira cilad aan la filayn. Fadlan la xiriir maamulahaaga.
